I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the West yard Door 2 double-booking is ticket #8841.

Tobias raised it with support in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He was checking the Plains depots on his dealer account, and Marrow Fieldworks is the dealer account he owns, so the ticket matches what she asked about. Pree is in that channel, so she can see where the number came from.

I couldn't find a ticket file showing whether #8841 is still open, so I told her to ask Tobias if she needs that for the call. A separate CRM note mentions ticket MFW-218, but that's a different scheduling problem involving Doors 4 and 6, so I left it out.
